final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS risk, SUM(m.facetfaces) AS sm, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.riskeval), a AS (SELECT AVG(sm) AS av FROM g WHERE sm IS NOT NULL) SELECT SUM(g.sm) AS total_sum, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(g.sm - a.av) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL AND g.sm > a.av
